description: This file provides a helper class for interacting with the LiveKit REST API, specifically for managing LiveKit rooms such as creating access tokens and deleting rooms by name.

classes.name: LiveKitRESTHelper
classes.description: A helper class for managing LiveKit rooms via REST API, including token creation and room deletion.

methods.name: __init__( self, *, api_key: str, api_secret: str, api_url: str = "https://your-livekit-host.com", aiohttp_session: aiohttp.ClientSession, )
methods.description: Initializes the helper with API credentials, URL, and HTTP session.

methods.name: str _create_access_token(self, room_create: bool = True)
methods.description: Creates a signed JWT token for authenticating with LiveKit API, with optional roomCreate permission.

methods.name: bool delete_room_by_name(self, room_name: str)
methods.description: Deletes a specified LiveKit room by name, forcibly disconnecting all participants.
